meta.title: Talismans that change weapon damage in the calculator

fields.group: Talismans of one group can't be worn together (the game allows one version of a talisman at a time).
fields.stats: Attribute points added before attack rating and stamina are worked out.
fields.damage: Multiplier on the attack of one damage type.
fields.attack: Multiplier on the attack of one kind of attack: charged (charged heavies), jump (jump attacks), finisher (the last light attack of a chain) or two-handed (every attack while two-handing).
fields.successive: Attack multipliers at the three stages of the successive-attack effect.
fields.after: Attack multiplier for some seconds after one of these statuses procs on the boss.
fields.assumed: Attack multiplier that depends on your own HP, which the calculator can't know: it is counted for a fixed share of the fight.

notCounted: Spear Talisman (needs to know which hits land while the boss is mid-attack)
Curved Sword Talisman (guard counters need a block first)
Dagger Talisman and Blade of Mercy (critical hits aren't modeled)
Retaliatory and Lacerating Crossed-Tree (attacks out of a roll, backstep or sprint)
Rellana's Cameo, Shard of Alexander, Godfrey Icon and the other skill and spell talismans
